guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The docker build fails because apt-get cannot locate the python3.11 and its related packages (python3.11-venv, python3.11-distutils) in Ubuntu 20.04 repositories. The error message is: "E: Unable to locate package python3.11" and similarly for python3.11-venv and python3.11-distutils. This is likely because Ubuntu 20.04 does not have Python 3.11 in its default package sources. To fix this, update the Dockerfile to add the Deadsnakes PPA repository before installing Python 3.11 packages. This can be done by adding the following command before the apt-get install line: 'add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa -y && apt-get update'. This will provide access to newer Python versions like 3.11 on Ubuntu 20.04. Then retry installing python3.11 and related packages. Also verify if python3.11-distutils is available via the PPA or needs to be installed via pip or other means.
